Read and compare the two Report Texts below for questions number 7 to 13!

Two Endemic Primates of Indonesia: Bekantan and Bornean Orangutan

TEXT 1: BEKANTAN (PROBOSCIS MONKEY)
Bekantan (Nasalis larvatus) is a reddish-brown arboreal monkey endemic to the island of Borneo (Kalimantan). Male bekantans are easily recognized by their unusually large, long nose and pot-bellied stomach. Unlike most primates, bekantans have partially webbed feet and hands, making them excellent swimmers. They live in coastal mangrove forests and riverside swamps, moving in social groups of 10 to 30 individuals. Their diet consists mainly of young mangrove leaves, seeds, and unripe fruits.

TEXT 2: BORNEAN ORANGUTAN
The Bornean Orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) is a large, shaggy reddish-ape native to the tropical rainforests of Borneo. Orangutans have very long, strong arms (spanning up to 2 meters) for swinging from branch to branch, and they do not have tails. Unlike bekantans, orangutans are mostly solitary animals and cannot swim across deep rivers. They build new leafy nests high in the trees every evening to sleep. Their favorite food is ripe forest fruit (especially durian and figs), bark, and insects.

[Membandingkan Dua Report Text — Pilihan Ganda Biasa] Based on Text 1 and Text 2, how do Bekantans and Bornean Orangutans differ in their social behavior and ability in water?
  • Bekantans live alone and cannot swim, whereas Orangutans live in large groups of 30 and love swimming.
  • Bekantans live in social groups (10–30 individuals) and are excellent swimmers, whereas Orangutans are mostly solitary and cannot swim across deep rivers.
  • Both Bekantans and Orangutans have long tails and webbed feet for diving in the ocean.
  • Neither Bekantans nor Orangutans live on the island of Borneo.
B
Bekantan hidup berkelompok (10-30 ekor) dan perenang ulung, sedangkan Orangutan hidup menyendiri (solitary) dan tidak bisa berenang di sungai yang dalam.

Read and compare Text A and Text B below for questions number 20 to 25!

TEXT A (Personal Recount):
Last Sunday morning, my older sister and I tried to make healthy banana oatmeal pancakes for our parents’ wedding anniversary. At first, we were so excited that we forgot to read my mom’s recipe notes. Instead of adding half a teaspoon of baking powder, I accidentally poured two full tablespoons of salt into the blender! When my dad took his first bite, his face turned bright red, and we all burst out laughing. In the end, we apologized and made a second batch carefully—which tasted delicious!

TEXT B (Procedure Text — Mom’s Recipe Note):
Healthy Banana Oatmeal Pancakes (Serves 2)
• Ingredients: 2 ripe bananas, 100g rolled oats, 2 eggs, 100 ml low-fat milk, 1/2 teaspoon baking powder, and 1 pinch of salt.
• Steps: (1) Blend the bananas, oats, eggs, milk, baking powder, and a pinch of salt until smooth. (2) Heat a non-stick pan over low heat. (3) Pour a ladle of batter and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear on top. (4) Flip carefully and cook for another 1 minute until golden brown. Serve warm with honey.

[Membandingkan Dua Genre Teks — Pilihan Ganda Biasa] How do Text A and Text B differ in their text type (genre) and communicative purpose?
  • Text A is a Recount Text that retells the writer’s past cooking experience, while Text B is a Procedure Text that instructs readers on how to make banana oatmeal pancakes.
  • Text A is a Report Text about bananas, while Text B is a Narrative Text about parents.
  • Both Text A and Text B are Descriptive Texts describing kitchen utensils.
  • Text A is an advertisement selling blenders, while Text B is a complaint letter.
A
Teks A adalah Recount Text menceritakan pengalaman lampau, sedangkan Teks B adalah Procedure Text memberikan petunjuk langkah membuat pancake.
SMP
7
D
Bahasa Inggris

Read and compare the two short Narrative excerpts below for questions number 26 to 30!

STORY 1: THE LEGEND OF SITU BAGENDIT (West Java)
Once upon a time in West Java, there lived a wealthy widow named Nyai Bagendit. She owned extensive rice fields and large chests of gold. However, she was extremely stingy and cruel. She never helped the starving villagers and would drive away beggars with harsh words. One day, an old poor man came with a wooden staff and asked for a cup of water, but Nyai Bagendit threw stones at him. The old man then stuck his staff into the ground and challenged her to pull it out. When none could, he pulled it out himself—and endless water gushed from the hole, flooding the whole village. Nyai Bagendit drowned along with her treasures, turning the area into Lake Situ Bagendit.

STORY 2: THE GOLDEN CONCH (KEONG MAS — East Java)
Long ago in the Kingdom of Daha, Princess Candra Kirana was cursed into a golden conch shell by a jealous witch and thrown into the river. An old poor widow named Mbok Rondo Dadapan found the beautiful shell in her fishing net and brought it home. Even though Mbok Rondo had very little food, she cared for the shell kindly. To her surprise, every day when Mbok Rondo returned from the forest, delicious meals were neatly cooked on her table by Candra Kirana. Eventually, Prince Inu Kertapati found Candra Kirana, broke the curse, and rewarded Mbok Rondo with a peaceful life in the palace.

[Membandingkan Karakter Dua Teks Naratif] How does the character of Nyai Bagendit in Story 1 contrast with Mbok Rondo Dadapan in Story 2?
  • Nyai Bagendit is rich but greedy and cruel, whereas Mbok Rondo is poor but generous, kind, and caring.
  • Both Nyai Bagendit and Mbok Rondo are cruel witches who cursed Princess Candra Kirana.
  • Nyai Bagendit is a poor fisherwoman, while Mbok Rondo is a stingy rice merchant.
  • Both characters drowned in a lake because they loved gold too much.
A
Nyai Bagendit digambarkan kaya raya namun kikir dan kejam, kontras dengan Mbok Rondo yang miskin namun tulus, murah hati, dan penyayang.

Last month, SMP Harapan Bangsa launched the "Bring Your Own Tumbler & Lunchbox" campaign. Before the campaign started, more than 450 kilograms of plastic waste ...(31)... from the school canteen every week. Today, every student brings a reusable bottle and lunchbox. Look! Right now, the student council members ...(32)... the clean canteen tables, and the plastic trash bins are almost empty. The principal said, "I ...(33)... all schools in our city will follow this green habit next year so our rivers become cleaner."

[Grammar in Context — Passive Voice] Which verb form best completes blank (31)?
  • is collected
  • will be collected
  • was collected
  • has collected
C
Keterangan waktu "Before the campaign started" dan "Last month" menunjukkan peristiwa lampau, sehingga bentuk pasif yang tepat adalah Simple Past Passive: "was collected".

  1. The phrase "Before the campaign started" indicates a past condition, which requires the Simple Past Passive (was collected). (Benar)

No. Statements (Pernyataan) True (Benar) False (Salah)

(b) The principal’s statement expresses a realistic future desire (hope + will + V1), not an impossible regret. ✓
